dialog.english:
Hey, it's Digitamamon's
restaurant! We had a lot of bad
memories here, didn't we, Matt?
dialog.translation:
¡Eh, es el restaurante de
Digitamamon! Aquí lo pasamos
fatal, ¿eh, Matt?

dialog.english:
Yeah... I was working hard, so I
could get back to T.K.
dialog.translation:
Sí... curraba duro para
poder volver con T.K.

dialog.english:
So both of you were working at
this restaurant?
dialog.translation:
¿Así que trabajasteis
los dos aquí?

dialog.english: Yeah, I made the food...
dialog.translation: Sí, yo hacía comida...

dialog.english:
...and I washed the dishes and
ingredients.
dialog.translation:
...y yo lavaba platos
e ingredientes.

dialog.english: I'm gettin' kinda hungry.
dialog.translation: Me está dando hambre.

dialog.english: Me too, actually...
dialog.translation: A mí también...

dialog.english:
Well, there's a kitchen here. Why
don't we all make food together?
dialog.translation:
Bueno, hay una cocina
aquí. ¿Por qué no cocinamos
todos juntos?

dialog.english:
We could all just straight-up
cook, but that'd be boring, so why
don't we have a cook-off!
dialog.translation:
¡Podríamos cocinar sin más,
pero sería aburrido, así que
hagamos un concurso!

dialog.english:
Sounds fun! The one with the worst
food has to wash the dishes.
dialog.translation:
¡Suena divertido! El que
cocine peor lava los
platos.

dialog.english: Then I won't lose!
dialog.translation: ¡Entonces no pierdo!

dialog.english: All right, then I'll be the judge.
dialog.translation: Vale, entonces yo seré el juez.

dialog.english: Me, too! So make a lot, okay?
dialog.translation: ¡Yo también! Haced mucho, ¿vale?

dialog.english:
Got any cooking experience,
Izzy?
dialog.translation:
¿Tienes experiencia
cocinando, Izzy?

dialog.english: Not quite, but I have my computer!
dialog.translation: ¡No, pero tengo mi ordenador!

dialog.english:
Finished! Please don't hesitate
and try it right away.
dialog.translation:
¡Terminado! Probadlo sin
dudarlo, ahora mismo.

dialog.english: Ughhhh...
dialog.translation: Uufff...

dialog.english: What kind of food is this?
dialog.translation: ¿Qué tipo de comida es esta?

dialog.english:
It's "Food for Thought"! I made it
incorporating the methods of
multiple countries.
dialog.translation:
¡Es "Comida Pensante"! La
hice combinando métodos de
varios países.

dialog.english:
The taste is too complex for me, I
don't really get it...
dialog.translation:
El sabor es muy complejo
para mí, no lo entiendo
bien...

dialog.english: I don't like this at all...
dialog.translation: Esto no me gusta nada...

dialog.english:
I... I can't believe... my "Food
for Thought" tastes bad...
dialog.translation:
Yo... no puedo creer...
que mi "Comida Pensante"
sepa mal...

dialog.english: Bleh... it tastes awful.
dialog.translation: Puaj... sabe fatal.

dialog.english:
Izzy, why didn't you try
tastin' the food while you were
cookin' it?!
dialog.translation:
Izzy, ¡¿por qué no probaste
la comida mientras la
cocinabas?!

dialog.english:
This is strange, I inspected the
recipe thoroughly...
dialog.translation:
Qué raro, revisé la receta
a fondo...

dialog.english: It's Ogremon!
dialog.translation: ¡Es Ogremon!

dialog.english: Why are you here?
dialog.translation: ¿Qué haces aquí?

dialog.english: Ghhh...! Gaaaaaaah!
dialog.translation: ¡Ghhh...! ¡Gaaaaaaah!

dialog.english: ?! Something's strange.
dialog.translation: ?! Algo va raro.

dialog.english:
He's real powerful, too! Let's
fight, Izzy!
dialog.translation:
¡Y es muy fuerte! ¡Vamos a
luchar, Izzy!

dialog.english: Ow ow ow... what's with all of ya?
dialog.translation: Ay ay ay... ¿qué os pasa a todos?

dialog.english:
That's what we'd like to know
about *you*.
dialog.translation:
Eso es lo que queremos
saber de TI.

dialog.english:
You started throwing a fit as soon
as you got here.
dialog.translation:
Empezaste a montar un
numerito en cuanto llegaste.

dialog.english:
Did I?!... I don't remember
anything after eatin' some
mushrooms from the roadside...
dialog.translation:
¡¿Yo?!... No recuerdo nada
después de comer unas setas
que encontré por el camino...

dialog.english:
Must have been hallucinogenic
mushrooms.
dialog.translation:
Debieron de ser setas
alucinógenas.

dialog.english:
I know! If you have any more
ingredients, please let me have
another attempt!
dialog.translation:
¡Ya sé! ¡Si tenéis más
ingredientes, dejadme
intentarlo otra vez!

dialog.english:
Doesn't matter what, just gimme
somethin' to eat!
dialog.translation:
¡Me da igual qué, dadme
algo de comer!

dialog.english: Here you are!
dialog.translation: ¡Aquí tienes!

dialog.english: Let's see...
dialog.translation: A ver...

dialog.english: It's delicious!
dialog.translation: ¡Está delicioso!

dialog.english:
Good. I thought you might have
lost your strength because of the
mushrooms...
dialog.translation:
Bien. Pensé que habrías
perdido fuerzas por las
setas...

dialog.english:
...so I made a soup that assists
in digestion.
dialog.translation:
...así que hice una sopa
que ayuda a digerir.

dialog.english:
Looks a lot better than that mess
you made earlier.
dialog.translation:
Se ve mucho mejor que el
desastre de antes.

dialog.english:
It truly is better to tailor food
to those who will eat it, rather 
than making something elaborate.
dialog.translation:
Es mejor adaptar la comida
a quien la come, en vez de
hacer algo muy elaborado.

dialog.english:
That was a pretty good meal! I
ain't got money on me, so I'll
give ya this.
dialog.translation:
¡Menuda comida! No llevo
dinero encima, así que
os doy esto.

dialog.english:
Oh! Older brother boy! We meet
again!
dialog.translation:
¡Oh! ¡Hermano mayor!
¡Nos vemos de nuevo!

dialog.english:
Aren't *you* the one who came up
here without warning?
dialog.translation:
¿No eres TÚ el que vino
aquí sin avisar?

dialog.english:
Hm! Is that what you're gonna say
to me? Then I'll give you this,
too!
dialog.translation:
¡Hm! ¿Eso me dices? ¡Pues
toma, esto también!

dialog.english: All right, I'm outta here!
dialog.translation: ¡Bueno, me piro!

dialog.english: He left as quickly as he came...
dialog.translation: Se fue tan rápido como vino...

dialog.english: How troublesome...
dialog.translation: Qué molesto...

dialog.english:
First, we should gather the
ingredients in this area. Um...
according to the recipe...
dialog.translation:
Primero, reunamos los
ingredientes de esta zona.
Eh... según la receta...

dialog.english:
DigiTaters, DigiTomatoes,
DigiCelery, and finally
DigiPineaps...
dialog.translation:
DigiPatatas, DigiTomates,
DigiApio, y por último
DigiAnanás...

dialog.english: Found DigiTaters!
dialog.translation: ¡DigiPatatas!

dialog.english: Found DigiTomatoes!
dialog.translation: ¡DigiTomates!

dialog.english: Found DigiCelery!
dialog.translation: ¡DigiApio!

dialog.english: Found DigiPineaps!
dialog.translation: ¡DigiAnanás!

dialog.english:
Let's keep at it and find the
remaining ingredients!
dialog.translation:
¡Sigamos y busquemos los
ingredientes que faltan!

dialog.english:
We've found all of the ingredients
for the recipe now.
dialog.translation:
Ya tenemos todos los
ingredientes de la receta.

dialog.english:
Let's go back to the restaurant
and start cooking!
dialog.translation:
¡Volvamos al restaurante y
empecemos a cocinar!

dialog.english:
Izzy... I don't like
vegetables, so please don't give
me anything with vegetables in it.
dialog.translation:
Izzy... no me gustan las
verduras, así que no me des
nada que las lleve.

dialog.english: No. You have to eat a balanced diet.
dialog.translation: No. Debes comer equilibrado.

dialog.english: I'll make it easier to eat them.
dialog.translation: Te las pondré fáciles de comer.

dialog.english: Mom says the same thing...
dialog.translation: Mamá dice lo mismo...

dialog.english: Well, I'll try to eat a little...
dialog.translation: Bueno, probaré un poco...

dialog.english: Please leave it to me!
dialog.translation: ¡Déjamelo a mí!

dialog.english: I'm pretty hungry!
dialog.translation: ¡Tengo hambre!

dialog.english: Do you cook at home, Izzy?
dialog.translation: ¿Cocinas en casa, Izzy?

dialog.english: My mother usually cooks for me.
dialog.translation: Normalmente cocina mi madre.

dialog.english: I can make things like boiled eggs.
dialog.translation: Sé hacer cosas como huevos duros.

dialog.english: Is that so...
dialog.translation: Ah, ya veo...

dialog.english: But making them well is difficult.
dialog.translation: Pero hacerlos bien es difícil.

dialog.english:
Boiled eggs seem easy, but they're
actually pretty hard. I'll teach
you how to make them sometime.
dialog.translation:
Los huevos duros parecen
fáciles, pero son bastante
difíciles. Te enseño algún día.

dialog.english: Really? Thank you!
dialog.translation: ¿En serio? ¡Gracias!

dialog.english:
I can't let myself lose this
contest, either!
dialog.translation:
¡Yo tampoco puedo perder
este concurso!

dialog.english:
I'm not good at cooking, and back
then I was breaking all the
dishes...
dialog.translation:
No se me da bien cocinar,
y en aquel entonces rompía
todos los platos...

dialog.english: It seems like you don't do it often.
dialog.translation: Parece que no lo haces a menudo.

dialog.english: Speed is part of making food.
dialog.translation: La rapidez es parte de cocinar.

dialog.english:
Were you in poor physical
condition?
dialog.translation:
¿Estabas en baja forma
física?

dialog.english:
T-that must have been it... I was
probably being unusually clumsy...
dialog.translation:
S-seguro que era eso...
Debía de estar torpe de
más...

dialog.english: No, that's not what I...
dialog.translation: No, no quería decir...

dialog.english:
You're likely to drop dishes more
often when you're cooking quickly.
dialog.translation:
Es normal que se caigan
más platos cuando cocinas
rápido.

dialog.english: You're right!
dialog.translation: ¡Tienes razón!

dialog.english:
My goal is to not break any dishes
today!
dialog.translation:
¡Mi meta es no romper
ningún plato hoy!

dialog.english:
I think I'll put fermented
soybeans in these fried eggs after
all.
dialog.translation:
Creo que pondré soja
fermentada en estos
huevos fritos.

dialog.english:
Yes... fermented soybeans are
delicious.
dialog.translation:
Sí... la soja fermentada
está deliciosa.

dialog.english:
Aren't they? All right, how about
putting fresh cream on kimchi
fried rice?
dialog.translation:
¿Verdad? Bueno, ¿qué tal
nata fresca en el arroz
frito con kimchi?

dialog.english: T-that sounds delicious...
dialog.translation: S-suena delicioso...

dialog.english: I think that might be impossible...
dialog.translation: Creo que eso es imposible...

dialog.english:
Then we'll go eat some as soon as
we get home!
dialog.translation:
¡Iremos a comerlo en
cuanto lleguemos a casa!

dialog.english: Ah, all right...!
dialog.translation: ¡Ah, vale...!

dialog.english:
Eeeeeeeh?! I bet your cooking's
just as bad, Izzy!
dialog.translation:
¡¿Eeeeeeeh?! ¡Seguro que tu
comida es igual de mala,
Izzy!

dialog.english:
The point is getting the perfect
balance of sweet and spicy!
dialog.translation:
¡La clave está en el
equilibrio perfecto entre
dulce y picante!

dialog.english: Return to the restaurant
dialog.translation: Volver al restaurante

dialog.english: Talk to everyone for a bit longer
dialog.translation: Hablar un poco más con todos

dialog.english:
Let's return to the restaurant
right away. I'll start cooking
with the recipe as reference!
dialog.translation:
Volvamos ya al
restaurante. Empezaré a
cocinar con la receta.

dialog.english:
We have to hurry up and
collect all the ingredients!
dialog.translation:
¡Hay que darse prisa y
reunir los ingredientes!

dialog.english:
We can't go there! We have to
hurry up, return to the
restaurant, and start cooking!
dialog.translation:
¡No podemos ir ahí! ¡Hay
que darse prisa, volver al
restaurante y cocinar!
